key_findings: Neuron/astrocyte-derived CXCL10 recruits spinal macrophages via CXCR3 and the JAK/STAT3 pathway to drive neuroinflammation and pain in experimental autoimmune prostatitis.
Targeting NGF (tanezumab) and mast cells (cromolyn sodium) reduced pain and spinal macrophage infiltration.
